style: Candid editorial nightlife photograph shot on a 35mm point-and-shoot film camera with hard direct on-camera flash: subjects crisp and bright, background falling off into deep black, slightly blown highlights, natural film grain, subtle vignetting, warm skin tones with coral-red and magenta accents from club lights, authentic and energetic, like a cool Gen Z party photographer's Instagram. Real-looking people aged 20 to 28, diverse, stylish casual outfits, genuine emotion and a bit of motion blur. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks, no drugs, no visible alcohol bottles. Vertical 9:16 framing, subject in the middle, room at the top and bottom for big text.
